title: A keyed value's curve opens where you want it
goal: The curve a keyed value runs on now opens inside its lane on the timeline. The video mock instead draws it as a collapsed Graph panel on the right. The user picks which one ships, and the loser goes.
notes: From a-layer-s-track-opens-into-one-lane-per-keyed-va (2026-09-23). Built in the lane (KeyLanesView.swift, KeyLaneView.curve/handles) because that task's acceptance said a curve view on a lane. The mock (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, #gGraph, .kfgraph) puts it in a collapsed dgrp in the right dock, x axis = clip duration. Core is shared either way: PhotonzDocument.keyGraph(layerID:motionID:) and setKeyHandle(...toGraphPoint:).
acceptance: The user has chosen between the curve in the lane and the Graph panel on the right
The chosen place is the only place the curve opens, at Next defaults
A walk with no flags opens the curve there and drags a Bezier handle
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Waiting on the user: curve in the lane (built) or the mock's Graph panel on the right
decision "Where should a keyed value's curve open: inside its lane on the timeline, or in a Graph panel on the right as the video mock draws it?" resolved: In the lane

Closed by triage 2026-09-28: already true.
